provenance: Redis 8.10.1 source documentation and machine-readable command declarations come from https://github.com/redis/redis/tree/3399357e7c17b668289386b8a15a3037bc4527b1. The imported command list matches COMMAND DOCS from Devline's pinned image sha256:335368721d328df9bf4779e9af816b0c8d3a87eddf1865fad80402b6b468f426, run with external networking disabled. Command syntax was captured from redis-cli help. The source declarations supply summaries, argument metadata, history, and reply schemas. Configuration samples and captured CLI help are shown as preformatted blocks. The supplementary guides come from the 2025-06-23 snapshot at https://github.com/redis/redis-doc/tree/1044224477fceacc5af56a636b0a7495d19e533c. Devline labels these guides by year, removes Hugo presentation markup, retains included CLI examples, and resolves legacy links and anchors to the vendored articles where possible. The archived guides use the separate CC BY-SA terms.
license: AGPL-3.0-only option (Redis 8.10.1 source reference) and CC-BY-SA-4.0 (archived Redis guides)
coverage: All 449 commands exposed by the pinned Redis image, including vector sets, with server and Sentinel configuration, CLI help, and 61 official guides on data types, persistence, transactions, scripting, security, and operations.
omissions: The archived guides predate 8.10.1 and omit interactive client examples and illustrations. The current Redis website manual and separately shipped modules are outside this snapshot.
